message.content:
A tailored wool-blend blazer in deep charcoal (#3a3f45), structured fit with notched lapels and single-button closure, falling to the hip.
A silk-blend blouse in soft oat (#d4c6b0), relaxed collar, slightly dropped shoulders, mid-length hemline.
Straight-leg wool trousers in forest green (#2e4a38), sharp crease from waist to ankle, full length.
Leather ankle boots in polished cognac (#9c5a40), block heel, rounded toe.
A thin cashmere scarf in muted burgundy (#722835), draped loosely around the neck.
This ensemble works perfectly for an autumn office day at 18 °C as it provides a warm yet breathable outer layer without overheating, striking a balance between professional polish and comfort. The neutral tones of the charcoal and oat ground the look while the forest green trousers add a sophisticated pop of color that complements her skin tone. The textured mix of wool and silk adds visual depth appropriate for a neat dress code, allowing her to move freely through meetings and casual moments alike.
